Name: Kids Visit - Babysit Jas and Vincent on Your Farm
Author: XI221
Description:
[size=5][b]Kids Visit[/b][/size]
Marnie is run off her feet at the shop and Shane isn't around; Jodi is running a whole household alone and can't keep an eye on Vincent. Sometimes they'll write: could you watch the kids for me today?

[size=4][b]A letter in the morning[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]On days without school (Monday, Thursday, Sunday), on a nice day that isn't a festival, Marnie or Jodi may write to you.
[*]You need 3+ hearts with Marnie / Jodi before they'll trust you with the kids.
[*]Read the letter and answer "Sure, send them over" or "Today's not good". You can say yes any time before noon.
[/list]
[size=4][b]At 9 AM the kids walk over[/b][/size]
Once you say yes, at 9 AM the kids leave home and [b]actually walk all the way to your farm[/b]: Jas comes through the forest from the south, Vincent comes in from the bus stop.

[size=4][b]A day on the farm[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]They play around the farmhouse door: skipping rope, running around, crouching by the field to look at the crops. If both kids come, they chase each other.
[*]If you have chickens, cows, a cat or a dog, they'll go and look.
[*]Around noon, if you're near the door, they run over to talk to you.
[*][b]They never step on your crops[/b], and they walk around your chests, machines and fences.
[*]At 4:30 PM they walk home on their own.
[/list]
[size=4][b]Look after them well[/b][/size]
Talk to them, give them something they like, let them see the animals and crops, and stay on the farm with them during the day - the happier their day, the better. The next day their parent sends a thank-you letter:
[list]
[*]Marnie sends eggs and milk (better the happier the kid was); Jodi sends a dish she cooked.
[*]If the kid had a really great day, they also slip in a little gift of their own.
[*]Every visit adds friendship with the kid and the parent - the happier the day, the more.
[*]No money: nobody here is well off, it's just neighbours helping each other.
[/list]
[size=4][b]Good to know[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Nobody asks on rainy days, festivals, weddings, or days the kid already has a vanilla plan (like a clinic visit).
[*]To uninstall, just delete the mod.
[*]Only runs on the host, and letters go to the host. Multiplayer hasn't been tested yet - please tell me in the comments if something goes wrong.
[*]May conflict with mods that change the kids' schedules (e.g. adopt-Jas type mods).
[/list]
[size=4][b]Feedback wanted[/b][/size]
Did the kids get stuck or walk somewhere strange? Were the gifts worth it? The English text is new - if a line reads wrong, please tell me.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
SMAPI 4.0+. Languages: English, Chinese.

Fan-made mod; Stardew Valley characters and art belong to ConcernedApe.

[size=4][b]中文[/b][/size]
帮忙看孩子：不上课的好天气早上（周一、周四、周日），玛妮或乔迪有时会写信托你照看贾斯、文森特一天（要和家长三颗心以上）。答应后孩子九点自己走到农场，在农舍门口一带玩、看动物和庄稼、中午跑来找你说话，不踩庄稼，四点半自己走回家。第二天家长寄谢礼信：玛妮送鸡蛋牛奶，乔迪送自己做的菜，玩得开心孩子还会附小礼物，都加好感。卸载直接删 mod。
